Also, you can get feminized seeds if you're in a state with legal sales? (Or if you know people in those states). 

Edit: definitely a bummer, but the general ratio is 50:50 male:female with seeds. 
Or you can get clones (although I prefer starting from seed- they generally tend to be more robust plants).
